draft_review_corrections_confirmed: Bind current seal and artifact members to the handoff/ACK instead of validating independent local and archive identities.
Require externally approved prefix ACK digests, exact contiguous attempted folders and previous ACK lineage.
Require explicit produced/not_produced declarations and preserve cleanup-unconfirmed attempts as unsealed.
Reject incomplete capture without an explicit stop, including the fully attempted final-cell case.

independent_controls.fixture_origin: Owner reusable CaptureFixture with invented three-cell schedule; local simulated readback bytes only.

post_test_documentation_qualification.change: Precisely scope begin/previous-ACK lineage verification to sealed/acknowledged cells; unsealed terminal folders retain denominator only.

review_findings: The externally pinned schedule and prefix tool-ACK digests bind fixed order and current sealed artifacts; rewriting local acknowledgment records cannot substitute a new root approval.
Every acknowledgment binds the current seal, artifact member map and archive hash; returned archive bytes are checked without extraction, with regular-file/name/hash/size constraints.

An outside hardlink to the archive is rejected. A distinct local copy plus invented trusted ACK can pass, explicitly demonstrating that this is byte verification plus attestation rather than independent proof of remote transfer.
Technical failures retain exact error and any declared partial/full response bytes. No later cell or retry follows a technical/guard failure even after its capture is attested.
Unconfirmed cleanup prevents sealing and continuation. Final accounting retains attempted_unsealed and every unattempted scheduled cell, with no durable-capture claim.
Missing scheduled cells or incomplete attempted capture require an explicit stop reason. Finalization is denominator/capture accounting, not an adequacy gate or native execution approval.
Exact optional artifact production declarations prevent silently relabeling an omitted declared artifact; truthfulness and completeness remain trusted caller obligations.
All journal mutation APIs refuse after finalization; actual native-resource enforcement, response grading and provider integration remain separate future work.
scope: Source-free independent review of the capture component only, using invented local fixtures. No native worker integration, experiment freeze, remote-transfer test or execution approval.
trust_limits: Actual remote persistence was not tested. Provider operation provenance and immutable object/version identity are supplied by the trusted root orchestrator; digest shapes alone do not authenticate them.
Matching archive and separately read-back bytes does not establish future retention or availability.
The component trusts one serial writer and truthful artifact-production, technical-outcome and cleanup metadata; it is not an OS sandbox against concurrent hostile writers.
Opaque artifact content is neither interpreted nor graded. Caller-provided technical status must not be based on answer correctness.
A durable-attested technical failure may appear in a complete capture; that state never implies reader competence or semantic success.
No full experiment protocol, native worker, provider integration, model trial or natural evaluation is authorized by this review.

An attempted_unsealed terminal folder is accounted for by scheduled position without certifying potentially incomplete begin metadata or ACK lineage. Full begin/lineage checks apply to sealed/acknowledged cells; the unsealed cell has no verified/durable claim and cannot advance.
